text:
lena: noticed a surge of KMS wrap failures from prod at ~09:12 UTC, looks correlated with the new onboarding SA we added yesterday. tagging @omar @kevin :eyes:
omar: can you attach the log snippet + SA email?
lena: pasted redacted snippet below:
```n{ "timestamp": "2026-03-23T09:12:45Z", "event": "kms.wrap_failure", "key": "projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/llm-wrap", "principal": "svc-onboarder@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com", "error": "insufficient_entropy" }
```
kevin: "insufficient_entropy" could be client-side RNG, or the wrapper flow we added. i'll repro locally.
olivia: we rolled out onboarding agent v2.1 yesterday. devops-bot, did that change KMS policies?
devops-bot: rollout #onboard-agent v2.1 deployed to prod at 2026-03-23T08:50Z. no KMS policy changes recorded.
omar: triage plan: (1) confirm SA activity + caller IPs, (2) repro wrap/unwrap with same SA against staging key, (3) capture full request/response headers. i'll take 1 & 3, kevin take 2.
lena: assigning tasks. keep updates concise here.
kevin: quick local test commands i will run:
```n# list key versions
gcloud kms keys versions list --location=global --keyring=prod --key=llm-wrap
# run onboarding wrapper
./onboarder --wrap --key=projects/redwood/... --sa=svc-onboarder@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
omar: audit logs show calls from internal infra subnets (legit). creating staging key to test. timeline ~30m.
olivia: could prod hosts have different RNG libs or FIPS flags? infra, any base-image changes?
kevin: we rolled a subset to debian-12-slim yesterday (image: rwood-deb12-2026-03-22). not expecting FIPS but will verify. i suspect our custom PRNG in v2.1. switching to OS RNG is low-risk.
lena: actions: kevin -> test OS RNG toggle + produce patch if passes (ETA 2h); omar -> instrument prod RNG health and add a temp watchdog/restart if pool low (ETA 1h); olivia -> open infra bisect ticket for base-image subset (ETA 4h).
omar: repro against staging succeeded with same SA credentials. points to prod environment difference.
kevin: pushed branch toggling RNG: https://github.com/redwood/onboarder/compare/fix/rng-oss. will deploy to staging.
olivia: i'll add to security sync and escalate to oncall if security-bot threshold hits.
security-bot: alert rule created: kms.wrap_failure > 100/hr (scope: prod). will notify #incidents if breached.
lena: also enabling verbose KMS audit export to BigQuery for 2h and capturing any additional metadata. include rotation decision steps in ticket.
omar: recommend rotation of llm-wrap key if failures persist or we detect malformed requests, but will wait for repro + approver. opening SEC-TRIAGE-482 and will paste logs + decision matrix.
kevin: staging patch looks good. plan B if prod still fails after agent restart + RNG switch: rotate key and rollback v2.1.
lena: thanks. keep updates short here. :white_check_mark:
